owner_summaries.key_concerns: Entity-level TB balances are not reconciled; FX rates coverage does not meet policy requirements.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level TB balances not reconciled to zero, leading to potential misstatements in financial reports.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Implement automated reconciliation tools and enforce stricter review processes.

residual_risks.description: FX rates coverage gaps may lead to inaccurate currency conversions and operational inefficiencies.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance FX rate validation controls and ensure policy adherence through regular audits.

residual_risks.description: High flux analysis exception count indicates potential non-compliance with variance thresholds.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Review exception thresholds and train staff on compliance requirements.
